arguments.content:
"""Create a team meeting calendar event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

# --- Determine next Wednesday (the first Wednesday strictly after today) ---
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == weekday 2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7
next_wed = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

print(f"Today: {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Wednesday: {next_wed.isoformat()} ({next_wed.strftime('%A')})")

# --- Determine local IANA timezone name ---
tz_name = "UTC"
try:
    from tzlocal import get_localzone
    tz_name = str(get_localzone())
except Exception:
    try:
        import time
        tz_name = time.tzname[0]
    except Exception:
        pass
print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")

# --- Event times: next Wednesday 15:00-16:00 local ---
dtstart_local = datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0)
dtend_local = dtstart_local + timedelta(hours=1)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@team-calendar"
dtstamp = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics_content = "\r\n".join([
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Team Calendar//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{dtstart_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{dtend_local.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team sync meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]) + "\r\n"

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics_content)
print("Wrote team_meeting.ics")

# --- Validate ---
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    with open("team_meeting.ics", "rb") as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(events) == 1, f"Expected 1 event, found {len(events)}"
    ev = events[0]
    print(f"Validation OK: '{ev.get('summary')}' "
          f"{ev.get('dtstart').dt} -> {ev.get('dtend').dt} (UID: {ev.get('uid')})")
except ImportError:
    assert "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in ics_content and "END:VCALENDAR" in ics_content
    assert "BEGIN:VEVENT" in ics_content and "END:VEVENT" in ics_content
    assert dtend_local > dtstart_local
    print("icalendar not installed; basic structural validation OK")
